prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right agency depends on what you need (services, industry, budget, timeline, company size, etc.). I can help you find the best fit. A few quick questions first:

- What marketing services do you need? (e.g., SEO, PPC, social media, creative/branding, content, web development, B2B demand gen)
- What’s your industry or target audience?
- Rough budget or monthly retainer range?
- Timeline or any must-have deliverables?
- Do you prefer a local agency (Baltimore/Annapolis/Rockville) or is remote OK?

How I can help next
- If you give the answers above, I’ll build a tailored shortlist of 4–6 Maryland agencies that match your needs (with strengths, possible drawbacks, and questions to ask each).
- Or I can show you how to evaluate agencies and give a few regional resources so you can compare on your own.

Quick guide to finding the right agency (if you want to search yourself)
- Use directories and reviews: Clutch.co, UpCity, G2, Google Business, LinkedIn.
- Check case studies and measurable KPIs (organic traffic growth, lead volume, CAC, ROAS).
- Ask for references and recent client contacts.
- Verify relevant industry experience and team expertise (platforms and tools they use).
- Look for transparency: reporting cadence, clear deliverables, and a trial project option.

Questions to ask agencies when vetting
- Can you show a case study with goals, strategy, and measurable results?
- Who will be my day-to-day contact and what does the team look like?
- Which tools and platforms do you use? How do you report performance?
- What results do you typically deliver for clients like me? What are reasonable timelines?
- Can you provide references from current or recent clients?

If you want, tell me the service/industry/budget details and I’ll create a customized shortlist of Maryland agencies and draft email/questions you can use to reach out. Which would you prefer?
